title: Bespoke Ceylon Honeymoon & Seclusion
summary: Couples’ sanctuaries, secluded private pools, candlelit ruins dinners, and unscripted leisurely ocean strolls — from the Cultural Triangle to the tea hills of Ella and a hidden cove near Tangalle.

cover.alt: Infinity pool of a boutique villa above jungle ravines and tea mountains

description:
A honeymoon should feel like it was made for two people only — and this one is. I choose villas for their privacy rather than their star rating, keep the driving light and leave every afternoon open.

Expect a candlelit dinner within sight of Sigiriya, a couples’ Ayurveda ritual, a reserved observation carriage through the tea country, three nights in a cliffside hideaway in Ella and a lantern-lit seafood dinner on a deserted cove.

overview.heading: Ten Days, Two Travellers, No Crowds
overview.quote: The most romantic moments here are rarely planned to the minute: a sudden shower over the tea, a king coconut at a mountain bend, the first stars over the Indian Ocean. I simply make sure you are in the right place for them.

days.title: Arrival & a Lagoon Sunset in Negombo
days.description: A private welcome at the airport and a short transfer to a lagoon-side villa. At sunset, a traditional oruwa boat glides you across the still water with a glass of something cold.

details.label: Curated Highlight
details.value: Sunset oruwa boat on the lagoon

days.title: To the Cultural Triangle & an Ayurveda Ritual for Two
days.description: We drive inland to a secluded villa near Sigiriya. In the afternoon, a resident Ayurvedic physician prepares a side-by-side ritual of warm herbal oils and a flower bath.

days.title: Sigiriya at Dawn & a Candlelit Dinner Beneath the Rock
days.description: An early, cool climb of the Lion Rock before the crowds (or a sunrise from Pidurangala), a lazy afternoon by the pool and, at night, a private candlelit dinner within sight of the floodlit citadel.

days.title: Kandy & the Evening Puja
days.description: Through the spice gardens of Matale to Kandy. In the evening we join the drum ceremony at the Temple of the Tooth, then dine above the lake.

days.title: The Observation Carriage to Ella
days.description: The full scenic railway from Kandy to Ella in reserved seats — tea estates, waterfalls and cloud forest for most of the day — while your luggage travels ahead to a cliffside villa.

days.title: Little Adam’s Peak at Sunrise & a Spa Afternoon
days.description: A gentle lantern-lit climb for sunrise over the Ella Gap, breakfast on your terrace, and an afternoon of spa treatments and doing absolutely nothing.

details.label: Curated Highlight
details.value: Sunrise from the eastern rock bench

days.title: Tea Tasting & the Nine Arches Bridge
days.description: A private tasting in a planter’s bungalow, then the Nine Arches Bridge from a quiet tea terrace as the blue train passes. Dinner by candlelight in your villa.

days.title: Down to the Sea at Tangalle
days.description: We descend past Ravana Falls to the south coast and a secluded villa above a quiet cove near Tangalle. The afternoon is for the pool and the sea.

days.title: A Lantern-Lit Seafood Dinner on a Deserted Cove
days.description: A free day by the ocean. At dusk I set up a lantern-lit seafood dinner on a hidden cove, just for the two of you; in season, we can quietly watch turtles nesting afterwards.

days.title: Farewell from the South Coast
days.description: A last swim and breakfast before the expressway takes us back to the airport.

details.label: Farewell
details.value: Ceylon tea and spice gift box

reviews.title: Intimacy, poetic beauty, and absolute privacy at every turn
reviews.text: We wished for an itinerary that bypassed the commercial circuit in favor of secluded boutique villas and quiet coastal moments. Dinesh coordinated our journey with extraordinary discretion. Whether booking the entire observation carriage section on the hill country railway or setting up a lantern-lit seafood dinner on a deserted Tangalle cove, Serendiva created magic.

related.title: Ayurveda, Healing & Forest Silence
related.summary: A restorative sanctuary journey designed to recalibrate mental and physical vitality. Daily consultations with resident Ayurvedic Vaidyas, endemic forest bathing, and private oceanfront meditation.

cover.alt: Open-air yoga shala above a lily pond in the Sinharaja rainforest

related.title: The Grand Ceylon Odyssey
related.summary: The quintessential Ceylon masterpiece. Climb Sigiriya at sunrise before the heat, wander sacred tooth relic temples, traverse the tea mountains on the vintage observation train, and track leopards in Yala.

cover.alt: Tea train crossing the Nine Arch Bridge in Ella in morning light

related.title: Wild Leopards & Untamed Coastlines
related.summary: Immersive expedition for wildlife photographers and conservation enthusiasts. Private trackers, custom open-sided 4x4 safaris, and private coastal yacht charters for sperm and blue whale sightings.

cover.alt: Open-top safari jeep watching a leopard on a granite boulder in Yala
